newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: TENNIS-HUBER OVERWHELMS HABSUDOVA FOR THIRD TOURNAMENT WIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HUBER OVERWHELMS HABSUDOVA FOR THIRD TOURNAMENT WIN.

text.p: Germany's Anke Huber won her third tournament of the season when she overwhelmed Slovakia's Karina Habsudova in the Luxembourg championship on Sunday.
A series of unforced errors led to Habsudova's 6-3 6-0 trouncing in just 50 minutes.
She gave Huber problems only for a brief spell in the first set when she recovered to 3-4 after losing the opening four games.
Habsudova's challenge then died with the loss of eight successive games.
